headline: YouTube Music adds labels for AI-generated songs
summary: YouTube Music is labeling tracks that are fully or partially AI-generated, mirroring its existing video labeling approach, and the labels are rolling out to YouTube video next.

claims.statement: YouTube Music is adding labels to identify AI-generated or AI-altered songs.

sources.quote: YouTube Music adds new labels for AI-generated content
YouTube sticks new labels on AI-generated songs
YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms
The AI music labels are rolling out now in YouTube Music

claims.statement: The label applies to tracks 'altered or fully generated' using AI, mirroring YouTube's existing video AI labels.

sources.quote: adding a "Made with AI" label to tracks that were "altered or fully generated" using AI, with a similar approach to its existing process for applying AI labels to videos

claims.statement: The label covers songs entirely or partially AI-generated, including composition and vocals.

sources.quote: The label will appear on the player page and include songs entirely generated by AI or partially, such as involved in composition and vocals

claims.statement: The labeling is rolling out now in YouTube Music and will come to YouTube video soon.

sources.quote: The AI music labels are rolling out now in YouTube Music and will come to YouTube soon.
